_note: Colour decisions for the composer and palette.py. Connotation is mostly carried by lightness, chroma and temperature (strong evidence), not by hue clichés (weak, cultural). Brand hues stay; the recipe moves lightness, chroma and proportion. "clusters" are the two colour clusters of references/tells.md (ground as an OKLab distance from a hex, with an OKLCH hue range and minimum chroma when the cluster's ground is tinted; accent as an OKLCH hue range with a minimum chroma); ground_alone means the ground by itself puts a plan near the cluster, because palette.py cannot see the type face.

dimensions.effect: brighter colours are rated more pleasant; darker more dominant and serious
dimensions.evidence: Valdez and Mehrabian 1994, J Exp Psych: General; strong for lightness-pleasure
dimensions.use: ground and accent lightness set the mood before hue does

dimensions.effect: more saturated colours are rated more arousing
dimensions.use: raise chroma for energy on one element; lower it for calm and rigour

dimensions.effect: warm hues read as near, active, human; cool hues as far, calm, technical
dimensions.evidence: long design tradition; experimental support mixed; treat as convention
dimensions.use: shift temperature across a piece to move from tension to calm or the reverse

dimensions.effect: wide value range reads as dramatic and serious; narrow as gentle and quiet
dimensions.evidence: design convention, consistent with fluency research
dimensions.use: set the value span per register

hue_associations._caveat: Associations vary by culture, context and brand. Jonauskaite et al. 2020 (Psychological Science, 30 nations) found shared patterns, shaped further by language and geography. Use as hints, never as rules; the brand teaches its own meaning.

harmonies.risk: muddy if all at the same lightness
vibration if both are saturated and large
busy beyond one accent per page

arcs.pages: neutral pages, one page in a full accent field

own._note: The palette of a piece with no --brand (palette.py own_brand). The register gives the accent a hue band (OKLCH degrees) and a base chroma, and the neutrals a hue and a chroma; the dealt harmony and arc choose the place in the band, and the neutrals' hue moves with it. The bands keep clear of the specimens' ultramarine (about 265 deg), of the clay accent of cluster 1 (30 to 55 deg) and of the amber the dark specimens use (about 80 deg). palette.py then steps each neutral away from the specimen palette and turns each accent away from the specimen accents, so these are starting points, not final colours. warm is the hue of the warm family a cooldown arc starts from. The hues are design judgement, not measured.
